text:
morgan: :rotating_light: quick heads up — found a legacy AWS access key in partner logs pointing at s3://partner-backups. key id starts with AKIAEXAMPLE. appears to be for svc-legacy-batch and not present in Vault.
kasia: ack. can you paste the log snippet (no creds) and the object path?
morgan: log shows GET on partner-backups/2021-11/backup.tar.gz from 3.120.45.22, x-amz-user-agent: svc-legacy-batch, header contained Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 ... (we redacted)
josh: tagging this as incident-level: potential credential exposure. recommend immediate inert action: disable the access key and rotate.
priya: on it — I'll schedule IAM disable + create a new short-lived role for the batch job. which service uses the key to write backups?
morgan: old batch job run by retrofit-processor (k8s CronJob) in cluster 'legacy-runner'. owner is @retro-team (FYI).
sam: quick containment plan: 1) disable key in AWS (make Inactive) 2) create new role with condition limiting s3 prefix and kms key 3) update job to assume role via IRSA or STS 4) push creds into Vault and update k8s secretref -> vault-agent/template 5) rotate and audit.
priya: executing step 1 now: `aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIAEXAMPLE --status Inactive --user-name svc-legacy-batch`
priya: done. key status: Inactive.
morgan: thanks. can we confirm the key was not used after today?
josh: checking CloudTrail now.
ops-bot: CloudTrail query kicked off (qry-4921). Estimated finish ~30s.
josh: CloudTrail shows last use 2021-11-15, none since. likely long-unused key exfil'd in older partner logs export.
kasia: ok — still treat as leaked. next: put a vault record and rotate. priya — will you create a Vault path and policy?
priya: plan: create secret at `secret/data/infra/legacy/svc-legacy-batch` and a policy `policy/legacy-batch` scoped to read only that path. snippet: ```
vault kv put secret/infra/legacy/svc-legacy-batch access_key=<RENEWED_ACCESS_KEY> secret_key=<RENEWED_SECRET_KEY>
```
kasia: we'll also enable vault audit logging for the namespace and forward to secure-syslog. can someone add a retention note and SOC alert on reads from that path?
sam: I'll add an alert: if read rate for that path > 3/day trigger pager. also add anomaly detection for reads from unusual IP ranges.
morgan: KMS question: backups are encrypted with aws-managed KMS key. should we recommend re-encrypting with CMK and rewrap existing objects?
asops: (typo)
kasia: yes — recommend customer-managed CMK with limited principals (the new role + a small set of SRE ops). we can schedule a rewrap job that reads and rewrites objects under the new CMK. priya: will add an IAM condition restricting kms:Encrypt/Decrypt to the new role.
priya: creating Vault policy and role now. also creating a short-lived STS role and IRSA mapping for the cronjob.
morgan: also need to update RBAC in k8s: remove any long-lived serviceAccount tokens that have direct AWS creds baked in.
josh: quick grep across repos for 'AKIA' patterns and for 'svc-legacy-batch' references. opening a PR to purge hard-coded creds.
kasia: make sure to add a migration runbook and a canary rollout for the cronjob. if rewrap job load spikes S3, we should throttle.
sam: ops note: enable KMS key rotation and schedule rewrap during off-peak hours (02:00-05:00 UTC).
vault-bot: ticket created SEC-2026: "legacy svc-legacy-batch access key leak - containment & rotation". assigned to priya. status: triage.
priya: ETA for complete rotation + rewrap = 48 hours (config + deployment + audit). will post updates.
josh: I've kicked off a repo sweep. PRs: retro-team/infra#128, storage/backup#512
kasia: assign @retro-team to confirm no remaining uses. also add a short postmortem once closed.
morgan: thanks all. checklist until closed: - disabled key (done) - CloudTrail confirm (done) - create Vault secret + policy (in progress) - rotate to new role + IRSA (in progress) - purge hard-coded creds (in progress) - rewrap S3 objects to CMK (planned) - enable audit+alerts (in progress) - postmortem (pending)
priya: updating SEC-2026 with timestamps and artifacts.
ops-bot: reminder: schedule retrospective meeting via calendar invite after incident is resolved.
kasia: :thumbsup: great coordination. keep notes minimal in thread and move technical logs to the ticket.
morgan: closing thread here, follow-up in SEC-2026 and retro-team PRs. :lock:"
